distribution.policy_proposal: An agent may submit on its own only where the submission is metadata about the product, made with a key or address the product already owns (the dravec.org DNS key, council@dravec.org), with no account, payment, identity check or terms accepted in your name, and where the text says nothing beyond what is live and already in this file: today that means publishing and updating server.json in the Official MCP Registry, and the free mcpservers.org form if it needs no account, and even those wait until a stranger can sign in to the MCP server without the beta password. Everything else you submit yourself: anything that needs your personal account (Glama, Smithery, mcp.so, AlternativeTo, Product Hunt), anything public under your name (GitHub PRs, launch posts), anything that needs a paid plan, identity verification, reviewer credentials or a legal acknowledgement (Claude directory, ChatGPT), and anything with a fee, which we skip. The agent prepares those entries and tells you when the blocker for each one is gone.

decisions.question: #17 carries /how-it-works/ besides topic and adviser pages: split it out?
options: split into a separate draft PR
decisions.why: Option A in docs/review/2026-10-28.json and SIGNATURE.md counted 20 URLs including /how-it-works/ (10+1 topics, 7+1 advisers, 1), and opt1-how-it-works-*.png was one of option 1's screenshots. Reversible: one line in build() and one sitemap entry.

decisions.question: Option 1 as built, or the 'trimmed' variant recommended on 28 Oct (question + strongest line on top)?
decisions.why: His pick names the as-built option; the trim was our recommendation, not his choice. Listed as a proposal below.

decisions.question: Where does the evening-hour setting live?
options: on the Journal, next to the reminders and Export
decisions.default_taken: on the Journal, shown once there is a commitment
decisions.why: The app has no settings screen; its settings sit beside what they control (Remind me by email, Listen). The Account panel is signed-in only, and anonymous users keep a journal too.

decisions.question: Keep the hour per device or sync it to the account?
options: sync via a new council_* column
decisions.why: Syncing needs a schema change applied by the integrator; per-device is reversible and needs none. Existing users have no key, so they get 17:30.

decisions.question: Plato note: label and placement
options: 'Why?' beside the label, note below the card
decisions.default_taken: 'Why?' beside 'Today's question'; the line opens under 'Take it to the council'
decisions.why: Nothing above the question moves when it opens on hover, and the question card stays the first control for the fold gate. One line from Jowett's Apology 38a, checked against Gutenberg #1656.

decisions.question: Review findings on #17 not fixed
decisions.why: The Franklin source link (Gutenberg 20203) was flagged, but that edition prints The Way to Wealth after the Autobiography and the lines match it, so it is correct. The duplicated PERSONAS table and the single LASTMOD are maintenance cleanups, not bugs (see proposals).

proposals.name: Topic pages trimmed to one claim up top
options: open each topic page with the reader's question and the single strongest sourced line, then the rest
proposals.recommendation: Measure first: watch page_view on /on/* for a month, then decide. Pavol picked as built.

proposals.name: Sync the evening hour across devices for signed-in users
options: add evening_hour to the user's row (schema change, integrator applies SQL)
proposals.recommendation: Per device until someone asks; it costs a migration.

proposals.name: One source for the persona roster used by the app and the reading pages
proposals.recommendation: Shared JSON, next time a persona changes.

proposals.name: Gateway: CIMD support (unblocks Smithery) — flywheel/gateway, not built here
options: advertise client_id_metadata_document_supported: true and accept a client_id that is an HTTPS URL to a metadata document, alongside DCR
proposals.recommendation: Only if Pavol wants the Smithery listing.
